CustomField.label: Legacy Id
CustomField.description: The Id this record had as an MA_Saved_Configuration__c row, for the handful of already-distributed guest URLs (?cfgId=<old id>) that predate the D6 rename. Salesforce Ids are permanently bound to their originating object, so an old link can never resolve directly against this record -- every guest-facing entry point that accepts a configId first tries it as a native Id, then falls back to a lookup here via GtmLegacyConfigId.resolve(). Blank on every record created after the cutover.
